equilibrium-constant.def: K: the value of products over reactants, each raised to the power of its coefficient, for a system at equilibrium at a given temperature. Kc uses molar concentrations, Kp partial pressures; pure solids and liquids are left out.

reaction-quotient.def: Q: the same expression as K, filled in with the concentrations or pressures present at any moment. Q < K means net forward reaction, Q > K net reverse, Q = K equilibrium.
